stem: A Massachusetts practitioner has a valid professional license and MCSR authorizing Schedule VI activity but does not yet have a DEA registration. Which prescriptions are within that Schedule VI-only credential situation, assuming no other scope problem? Select all that apply.

explanation.core_reasoning: An MCSR-only practitioner can conduct approved Schedule VI activity, but federally controlled Schedules II-V require corresponding DEA registration.

choice_analysis.B: Insulin glargine is an ordinary Schedule VI prescription drug.
choice_analysis.C: Gabapentin is Massachusetts Schedule VI even though it is PMP-reportable.
choice_analysis.D: Pregabalin is federal Schedule V and requires DEA authority.
choice_analysis.E: Methylphenidate is federal Schedule II and requires DEA authority.

related_facts: Gabapentin's PMP status does not make it federally controlled.
explanation.mpje_trap: Using MassPAT reporting as a proxy for DEA scheduling.

reasoning_steps: Separate Massachusetts Schedule VI from federal II-V
